items.title: 6 months to live for open models
items.summary: The most serious test to date of open source AI’s viability is happening right now. I’ve seen many waves of anti open-source AI rhetoric come and go since ChatGPT was launched, but none of them had obvious analogues in their potential enforcement to real action already in place targeting the peer, closed models of the day. items.title: “母病速归”式 AI：号称省 65% Token，实测只有 8.5%
items.summary: 让 AI 像原始人一样说话，确实能省一点 Token，但真正昂贵的是上下文、工具调用和返工。
items.summaryZh: 针对GitHub上大热的、号称能大幅节省Token的原始人说话风格提示词工具Caveman，JetBrains进行了严格的基准测试。测试表明其输出Token的实际降幅远低于宣传数字，且在复杂的代理工作流中，极度简化的表达可能缺乏必要的纠错冗余，容易引发后续误解。
